column1: # EASA FIR code -> VATSIM vatspy-data-project boundary ids, for codes with no whole-FIR polygon of their own.
# Basis: sector and ACC names in VATSpy.dat [FIRs] (VATSIM vatspy-data-project, CC BY-SA 4.0), read 2026-11-18.
# Simulator sectors, not official FIR boundaries: spot-check against AIP before any claim rests on one of these.
# VATSIM's base ULLL polygon is partitioned without gaps by ULLL-R (Peterburg) + AR + MR + KT + W + S + NM (Naryan-Mar) + MO (oceanic);
# EASA lists ULLL separately from ULAA/ULKK/ULMM/ULWW/UUYY, so EASA ULLL is mapped to ULLL-R only. NM and MO are left unassigned.
